class: A required mark drawn apart from its question, and patterns silently broken by a control character
symptom: Rackspace (Workday) Application Questions: with the AI unavailable, the agent took the required AI-screening consent question ('Select One', its star on a line of its own) for optional and pressed Next three times into Workday's 'Errors Found' panel, until the loop guard stopped it with 'stuck in a validation loop'. While fixing it, three regular expressions were found to hold a backspace character where a word boundary was meant: 'browse' was never read as an upload button, 'I agree / accept / consent' never as a consent button, and a phone box labelled 'Country' never as a dial code.
site: Workday (Rackspace); every site for the three patterns
root_cause: carry_on_without_the_ai() judged 'required' only by a star in the question text; Workday draws the star apart and names the list '<question> Select One Required'. It did not read the page's own errors before pressing on. The broken patterns came from scripted edits whose escape sequences turned '\b' into the backspace character.
why_tests_missed: The no-AI tests had required questions marked with a star in the label; none had Workday's separate star or an errors panel. Nothing checked source files for control characters, and a regex holding one compiles and simply never matches.
fix: carry_on_without_the_ai() also counts as required any list named '... Required' still unanswered, and stops when page_errors() finds errors; the stop names the questions ('needs your answer (the AI is unavailable): ...'). The six backspace characters in page_agent.py and browser_automation.py are word boundaries again, and tests/test_source_has_no_control_characters.py fails on any control character in a source file.
prevention: Decide 'required' from every mark a form uses (a star anywhere near, 'Required' in the name, aria-required, an error after Next), and check what the page says before pressing on. Write code edits through files, not through shell strings that process escapes, and keep a test that source holds no control characters.
